'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] names [[Bismillah Khan Mohammadi]] as his new defense minister and Abdul Sattar Mirzakwal as the new [[Ministry of Interior Affairs (Afghanistan)|interior minister]], replacing their respective predecessors amid a deteriorating security situation, with foreign forces withdrawing from the country and the [[Taliban]] gaining territory, capturing six more [[districts of Afghanistan|districts]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-president-ashraf-ghani-sacks-ministers-amid-deteriorating-security/a-57965826 (DW)]
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**Saudi air defenses destroy six armed drones late in the evening, bringing the total of armed drones destroyed during the day to 17. A [[Houthi]] spokesman says that one drone was launched at [[Khamis Mushait]] while the Saudi air defenses say that two other drones toward Khamis Mushait were intercepted and that eight other drones were also launched toward the south of the kingdom. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-air-defences-intercept-houthi-armed-drone-says-state-tv-2021-06-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] reports a record 20 deaths from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 414. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2135003/cambodia-reports-record-20-covid-deaths (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Laos]]
****[[Laos]] extends its [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] measures for another 15 days until July 4 as the number of community transmission cases of COVID-19 continue to increase. [https://laotiantimes.com/2021/06/19/laos-extends-lockdown-measures-for-further-15-days/ (''The Laotian Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] reports a record 14 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 439. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-06/19/c_1310016828.htm (Xinhuanet)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indiana]]
****[[Indiana]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]] of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.wthr.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/delta-variant-of-covid-19-detected-in-indiana/531-3c32d62a-5969-48cd-a168-d8abc8be32fd (WTHR-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] surpasses 500,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]], becoming the second country to do so after the [[United States]]. [https://amp.dw.com/en/brazil-exceeds-500000-covid-19-deaths/a-57956562 (DW)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
***[[Fiji]] reports a record 150 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the national toll to 1,798. The [[Ministry of Health (Fiji)|Ministry of Health]] reports that most cases are from known clusters while others are under investigation. Also, [[Australia]] and [[New Zealand]] announce that they will deploy doctors to Fiji to help deal with the increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/445099/fiji-covid-19-150-cases-as-nz-and-australia-medics-prepare-for-deployment (RNZ)] [https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/news/covid-19/150-new-covid-19-infections-new-cluster-identified/ (FBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–China relations]]
**[[Australia]] begins lodging a formal complaint against [[China]] with the [[World Trade Organization]] over anti-dumping duties on imported [[Australian wine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/jun/19/australia-takes-china-to-wto-over-its-trade-sanctions-on-australian-wines (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Six people are critically wounded as a man intentionally drove his [[pickup truck]] into a group of cyclists taking part in a charity bike ride in [[Show Low]], [[Arizona]]. The driver is shot and arrested. The motive behind the attack is unknown so far. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57542454 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Brazilian protests]]
**As [[Brazil]] reaches [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil|500,000 deaths due to COVID-19]], demonstrations are held in hundreds of Brazilian cities and by [[Brazilian diaspora|Brazilians abroad]]. Protestors are critical of [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]'s handling of the pandemic and demand his [[impeachment]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/jun/19/fresh-protests-in-brazil-against-bolsonaros-handling-of-covid-pandemic (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2021 Iranian presidential election]]
**Rival candidates concede victory to [[Iranian Principlists|hardline]] Chief Justice [[Ebrahim Raisi]], who was widely predicted to be the next [[President of Iran|president]]. An official from the Interior Ministry claims that Raisi won 17.8 million votes out of the 28 million votes cast. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/irans-sole-moderate-presidential-candidate-congratulates-raisi-his-victory-state-2021-06-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]] 
**Protesters against the [[Tatmadaw|military]] [[Military junta|junta]] carry out a national day of "flower protest" to celebrate the 76th birthday of deposed leader [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] and condemn her arrest. The flower symbol was allegedly chosen because Suu Kyi is often seen with a flower on her head. Protests supporting the military junta led by [[Min Aung Hlaing]] also occur across the country. [https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-flower-protests-mark-aung-san-suu-kyis-76th-birthday/a-57962893 (DW)]
*[[2021 Peruvian general election]]
**Supporters of [[Pedro Castillo]] and [[Keiko Fujimori]] gather following the election. Castillo supporters call for his win to be upheld, while Fujimori supporters call for the results to be overturned. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/20/rival-protests-in-peru-as-tensions-rise-over-presidential-vote (Al Jazeera)]
